doc: Ghost powers (features/souls/README.md): each row is one soul's power. Activation costs madness_cost on the Madness meter (pitch section 5; a stub: it rises on use, decays at madness.decay_per_s, and a power whose cost would pass madness.max is refused). A power runs duration_s, then cools down cooldown_s; only one power runs at a time. interrupt_on lists the reasons that end it early (hit, stunned, car, knocked_down). bark_on/bark_off are voice line ids (audio lands later). action is the InputMap action in input_actions.json. hauler and gearbox hold each soul's own tuning.

gearbox.doc: Gearbox: remote-hijack a car in view. The soft lock takes the nearest car within lock_radius_m of the reticle and range_m of Rivet; the car then drives at drive_mps toward the reticle, turning at most turn_dps, and wrecks on a contact above crash_mps. Rivet stays on foot and steers (his move is scaled by rivet_move_k while linked): the cost.

hauler.doc: Hauler: Rivet becomes the bulky ghost tank (body class body_class, bodies.json). morph_s is the readable grow/shrink; the tank moves at most top_mps, accelerates at accel_mps2 (momentum: no instant stop) and turns at most turn_dps. Ram: above ram_mps a contact knocks down humans and robots (the tackle matrix) and damages a car by ram_car_damage. Stomp: arm() starts a stomp_windup_s telegraph (readable, dodgeable), then a radial shockwave of stomp_radius_m, knockdown inside stomp_knock_m, stun stomp_stun_s, every stomp_cooldown_s.
